summary: Phase C (student performance tracker) tested end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase_c.py (7 pytest cases) covering: dashboard phase-C fields (at_risk_students, avg_completion), /admin/students list shape (progress_percent, lessons_completed, last_active, status), /admin/students/{id} shape (metrics {percent, lessons_completed, lessons_total, last_active, status, per_course[modules]}, timeline, admin_notes), PATCH notes persistence, and the full E2E flow: student logs in -> POST /courses/{id}/lessons/{lesson}/progress completed=true -> admin re-GET sees lessons_completed increment, last_active populated, status 'active', per_course percent raised, timeline includes 'lesson' entry, and list endpoint reflects same values. All 7 tests pass. Frontend playwright run: admin login OK, /admin dashboard renders 6 stat cards including stat-at-risk and stat-avg-completion, /admin/students shows status filter buttons (All/Active/At risk/Completed with counts e.g. 'All (11)'), filtering + search both work, clicking a row opens the detail modal with student-metrics (4-metric header shows 33% / 1/3 / Oct 8 2026 / Active for demo student after the lesson completion from the backend E2E test), course-progress-{id} blocks with per-module bars (Starting Conversations 1/3), activity-timeline shows Completed lesson entry, admin-notes textarea + save-notes-btn persist, toggle-disable-btn / clear-sessions-btn / grant-course-select / grant-course-btn present. Avg_completion returned 50 (int %) and at_risk_students returned numerically. Regression: /api/services still public, /api/courses still 200. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py dashboard() iterates every actively-enrolled user and calls student_metrics() per user, each of which hits enrollments + courses + progress collections. O(users * courses) DB roundtrips - fine today (11 students) but will degrade. Consider a single aggregation or memoising per-course lesson_ids.

student_metrics() computes last_active by max(enrollment.last_accessed, latest progress.updated_at). It parses with datetime.fromisoformat but ignores 'Z' suffix - will raise and be swallowed as None if any legacy ISO string ends in 'Z'. Verify now_iso() format consistency.

at_risk is computed off a 7-day idle threshold, but seed/mock data never produces that state naturally in a fresh env; consider an admin-tunable threshold or a backdoor to synthesise at_risk in staging.
AdminStudents modal does not auto-refresh the row count/filter badges after a grant_course_id patch - only after reopening page. Minor UX, not a bug.
